description: This file implements the SambaNova Speech-to-Text (STT) service, integrating with SambaNova's Whisper API for real-time audio transcription. It defines a class that extends a base STT service, initializes parameters such as model, API key, and language, and implements an asynchronous transcription method that constructs and sends a request to the API.

classes.name: SambaNovaSTTService
classes.description: A service class for interfacing with SambaNova's Whisper API to convert audio to text. It allows configuration of model, API key, language, prompt, and temperature, and provides an asynchronous method for transcribing audio bytes.
